tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Contact details and facts about Sabag 3D Studio, a 3D printing studio in Israel: phone, WhatsApp, email, address, opening hours, area served, price level. Use before telling a person how to reach the studio.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The studio's services (architectural scale models, custom 3D printing) and main pages, with links.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search pages, past projects, products and guides. Use for any question about what the studio has done or sells.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Portfolio of completed projects (newest first). Optional type: a slug from list_project_types.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: A past project with its full description (markdown).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Ready-made 3D-printed products with price (ILS) and availability.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: A product with its description and FAQ.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions about prices, files, materials, timing and delivery.

tools.name: get_quote_options
tools.description: Choices for request_quote (project type, scale, material, colour). Free text is accepted too.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to the studio for a person, like the site's quote form. Ask the person first: use only their real name and phone or email, describe the project in message, and set consent to true only after they agreed to be contacted. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: get_business_info, get_faq · Public sink: get_business_info, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: get_business_info, get_faq · Public sink: get_business_info, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
